headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 8 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL at $52.2bn followed by Solana and Base. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.48bn while Tether generated the most fees. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoin circulation with multiple peg deviations flagged. Base and Arbitrum hold the largest L2 TVS figures amid recent protocol incidents.
